scope: direct and supplementary Naming audit for locally available baseline artifacts

artifact_coverage.reporting: report evaluable artifacts over the frozen requested cohort before Naming metrics
artifact_coverage.failed_generation: exclude missing artifacts from per-asset Naming means, but never hide them from artifact coverage

units.urdf_part: one URDF link with at least one valid renderable visual geometry; multiple visuals on one link are merged for part counting

urdf_renderable_geometry.mesh: a nonempty filename resolving to a nonempty file inside the frozen package
urdf_renderable_geometry.unsupported_or_invalid: does not make the link Naming-evaluable

units.empty_group: a link or node without mesh geometry; excluded from Naming
units.representation_rule: URDF-link and GLB-node results must be labeled separately unless a converter-preservation audit proves equivalence

nameability.formula: named mesh-bearing parts / all mesh-bearing parts

cross_seed.eligible_methods: reusable generators with at least two successful seeds per frozen factory or template
aggregation: pair-micro over all eligible within-factory seed pairs
factory median and 95 percent bootstrap confidence interval
cross_seed.semantic_label_rule: raw name metrics must not be called role consistency without independent role gold

semantic_metrics.requires: frozen output-independent role gold plus three independent blind judges under naming_protocol_v2

prohibited_inferences: do not infer semantic correctness from readable source names
do not treat unmatched named parts as false positives without judges
do not copy paper values into a local-rerun row
do not compare raw URDF-link counts to GLB-node counts without a representation note
